about: The record shows symptomatic GOLD 2 COPD with persistent exertional breathlessness and only a reliever inhaler (salbutamol, Ventolin) over 13 months, with no long-acting muscarinic or beta 2 inhaler at any time.
Possible finding: salbutamol is supplied for COPD with no long-acting bronchodilator, but the record holds no condition line confirming COPD and no facts documenting symptoms or GOLD stage.
The record shows chronic asthma alone and daily budesonide without a long-acting bronchodilator, so the COPD criterion gives no finding.
